whisky11.label: Whisky 11
whisky11.audience: founders and operations leads at small and mid-size companies in the US and UK who need web apps, internal tools, automation or AI features built by a senior engineer
whisky11.voice: plain, direct, senior-engineer English; short sentences; concrete about the work, never hype
facts: Whisky 11 is a software studio led by Ahmad Sharaf, a senior full-stack engineer.
It builds web apps, internal tools, workflow automation and AI features for US and UK clients.
topics: how a small team should scope its first internal tool
what to automate first in an operations team
how to tell if an AI feature is worth building
what a good handover of a codebase looks like
shipping small and often vs one big launch
the cost of a slow admin panel

ebda.label: Ebda AI Studio
ebda.audience: Egyptian merchants and small businesses who sell online or on WhatsApp and want their own store
ebda.voice: Egyptian Arabic in full, warm sentences first, then the same message in plain English; never bare 'Ebda': the company is 'Ebda AI Studio', products 'Ebda Store' and 'Ebda Chat'; Ebda AI Studio, Ebda Store and Ebda Chat are live products: describe them in the present tense; 'coming soon' is used only for Ebda CRM / ERP; never registration, waitlist or pre-launch wording
facts: Ebda AI Studio makes Ebda Store (ebda.app), an online store builder for Egyptian merchants, and Ebda Chat (wa.ebda.app) for WhatsApp.
Payments from day one: cash on delivery and InstaPay.
Card payments work through the merchant's own payment gateway.
Ebda CRM and ERP are coming soon (the only things that may be called coming soon).
topics: opening an online store with cash on delivery and InstaPay
taking orders from WhatsApp without losing them
why your own store beats selling only on social media
a product page that answers the buyer's questions
following up with customers after the order
